target: acceptance 8 — a spec that went reviewing->building->reviewing reports its FINAL cycle, not a sum: summing double-counts code that was rewritten rather than added. Its reopen count is shown alongside so a one-cycle and a five-cycle spec are never presented as comparable.
cmd: mkdir -p .agentic/observability; printf "%s" '{"observability":{"enabled":true}}' > .agentic/config.json; cp "$FIXTURES/comprehension/events.jsonl" .agentic/observability/events-20260801.jsonl; unset CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR AGENTIC_OBSERVE; "$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/observe_metrics.sh" comprehension 2>/dev/null | jq -c 'map(select(.spec|test("901-b")))[0]'
